contracts: Six target first-use cases: four read mapping strategies and two object-layout writer strategies on 200 records with Name/Id/Date/Value.
Sixteen fresh child processes per case; zero warmups, one actual iteration and one invocation per child. No Pilot, adaptive repetition or explicit Jitting stages occur in the native measurement list.

GlobalSetup and assembly description run before timing. Read setup creates the workbook using peer writer APIs and checks ZIP shape without target ColdStartRecord mapping. Write setup constructs source ColdStartRecord instances. Related APIs and constructors may be initialized or JIT compiled before timing.

Timed scope includes the first target mapping-plan/layout use and reachable JIT/code initialization still deferred after setup, plus complete workbook open/read or write/save/disposal. This is not process startup or first-ever usage of every library API.

Cold reads enforce the Id checksum; timed writers return length. Complete four-field read mapping and parsed writer output are validated in a separate frozen-harness process. No timed writer per-invocation output hash or full-field validation is invented.

Short individual cold operations and minimum-duration warnings are expected for this contract. Repeating work to force a >=100ms iteration would replace first use with warm throughput. Cold results are not ranked with warm cases.

Allocated bytes report the subsequent BenchmarkDotNet 0.15.8 MemoryDiagnoser diagnostic invocation (second use). The first target mapping/layout latency remains separate. The allocation boundary is source-derived from the prior pinned Engine.Run/GetExtraStats review, not a separately timed second-use operation or first-use initialization allocation measurement.

hostObservation.limitation: Pre/post snapshots do not identify process roles, CPU during individual cases, or activity of processes absent at either endpoint. They do not prove an idle host or establish causal contamination. Fresh benchmark children and generated builds occur within the capture; original snapshots are retained. No live host audit or later-group inspection.

contracts.CsvDirectAggregateBenchmarks: Three original full files,DOP1. Peer CsvParallel.AggregateAsync uses UTF8 ref/struct fields and independent native states; OfficeIMO public AggregateTextRowsAsParallel reads/decodes whole file inside timing, public AggregateRowsAsParallelAsync path/stream reads incrementally with decoded UTF16 field snapshots. All6 heavy fields/all3 narrow integers consumed; states sum Units/A and count rows without mapped result arrays. Every consumed field and repeating-row multiplicity is proved in Setup. UTF8 versus decoded text/materialization pipeline remains explicit; bounded retained state is not low cumulative allocation.
contracts.CsvParallelTypedBenchmarks: Same4.3M/8M/3M full files,DOP1. Same materialized heavy6-field/narrow3-integer classes across automatic peer CsvParallel/attribute sequential parser, OfficeIMO Core.RowsAsParallel, public decoded-text factory ReadTextRowsAsParallel, Sylvan GetRecords sequential. Text factory includes File.ReadAllText/UTF8 decode in each timed call. Each engine Setup checks every mapped field/source order/count before timing; result rows are consumed into same Units/A checksum. Parallel and sequential pipelines remain distinct.

contracts.CsvMaterializedReadBenchmarks: 50K headerless four fields. Every engine materializes Name and parses int/DateTime/double. OfficeIMO/Sylvan typed getters versus peer cell conversion; every field/order/count checked in Setup.
contracts.CsvRawAsyncBenchmarks: 50K headerless, materialized Name and three typed scalars. Timed memory-stream opening/async traversal/disposal. OfficeIMO/Sylvan async open versus peer synchronous FromCsv open then async enumeration. Actual methods validate each row in Setup; no disk/network async latency claim.
contracts.CsvRawReadBenchmarks: 50K headerless original fields. Peer borrowed UTF8 Name/cell parsing, OfficeIMO normalized borrowed UTF8 all fields/scalar parsing, Sylvan borrowed UTF16 Name/native typed getters. Public provider borrows exact normalized UTF8 already held by native stream source; conversion/text-parser fallbacks unavailable. Whole parser/opening pipelines remain distinct. ASCII byte/char lengths coincide. Every ordinary scalar/text value validated, borrowed methods count/checksum checked.
contracts.CsvRealDataMaterializedReadBenchmarks: Pinned real CSV65,536 rows including header/14 string fields. All engines materialize every field. Every field/type/order/span/UTF8 byte checked against independent Sylvan oracle; opening pipelines differ.
contracts.CsvRealDataReadBenchmarks: Same pinned real14-column input/header included. Peer ReadOnlyMemory or stream borrowed UTF8; OfficeIMO stream normalized borrowed UTF8; Sylvan StreamReader borrowed UTF16 spans. Every field/type/order/span checked; ASCII7,253,335 byte/character sums coincide. Representation/opening costs remain distinct.
contracts.CsvRecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared objects+header,new4MiB destination/finalization. Mapped=false/true: peer attribute/generated WriteRecordsAsync versus OfficeIMO WriteObjects ordinary object mapping. Invariant O dates for OfficeIMO; every header/value/type/date/order checked by OfficeIMO/Sylvan. Automatic writer strategies and async/sync contract disclosed.
contracts.CsvTypedAsyncBenchmarks: 50K headered identical TypedRecord class. OfficeIMO RowsAsAsync/async opener, peer attribute parser async enumeration/sync FromCsv opener, Sylvan GetRecordsAsync/async opener. Setup validates every field through actual methods; memory stream does not measure external async IO latency.
contracts.CsvTypedReadBenchmarks: 50K headered complete Name/Id/Date/Value class. Automatic OfficeIMO RowsAs, peer attribute parser, Sylvan GetRecords. Every mapped field/order/count validated in Setup; distinct from raw/manual construction.
contracts.CsvUtf8WriterBenchmarks: 100Kx4 unmanaged offsets/value buffers,no header,reused32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Public CsvRowWriter.WriteUtf8Row versus peer row.WriteUtf8. Same CRLF6,900,000B output/all bytes and fields checked, plus escaping/Unicode/null/empty/formula proof. No private NativeWriteApi adapter.
contracts.CsvWideReadBenchmarks: 50Kx32 ASCII fields/headerless. MaterializeStrings=false: peer borrowed UTF8, OfficeIMO normalized borrowed UTF8, Sylvan UTF16 spans; true materializes every field. Every1.6M-field value/order/width/count checked. ASCII length equivalence does not remove representation/parser allocation differences.
contracts.CsvWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared typed objects+header,new4MiB destination/full finalization. Peer row writer, OfficeIMO WriteObjects invariant O dates/default newline, Sylvan ObjectDataReader/CsvDataWriter default format. Every logical field/type/date/order checked independently. Valid formatting/output-length differences prohibit an identical-byte/format cost claim.

contracts.CsvMaterializedReadBenchmarks: 50K headerless four fields. Every engine materializes Name and parses int/DateTime/double. OfficeIMO/Sylvan typed getters versus peer cell conversion; every field/order/count checked in Setup.
contracts.CsvRawAsyncBenchmarks: 50K headerless, materialized Name and three typed scalars. Timed memory-stream opening/async traversal/disposal. OfficeIMO/Sylvan async open versus peer synchronous FromCsv open then async enumeration. Actual methods validate each row in Setup; no disk/network async latency claim.
contracts.CsvRawReadBenchmarks: 50K headerless original fields. Peer borrowed UTF8 Name/cell parsing, OfficeIMO normalized borrowed UTF8 all fields/scalar parsing, Sylvan borrowed UTF16 Name/native typed getters. Public provider borrows exact normalized UTF8 already held by native stream source; conversion/text-parser fallbacks unavailable. Whole parser/opening pipelines remain distinct. ASCII byte/char lengths coincide. Every ordinary scalar/text value validated, borrowed methods count/checksum checked.
contracts.CsvRealDataMaterializedReadBenchmarks: Pinned real CSV65,536 rows including header/14 string fields. All engines materialize every field. Every field/type/order/span/UTF8 byte checked against independent Sylvan oracle; opening pipelines differ.
contracts.CsvRealDataReadBenchmarks: Same pinned real14-column input/header included. Peer ReadOnlyMemory or stream borrowed UTF8; OfficeIMO stream normalized borrowed UTF8; Sylvan StreamReader borrowed UTF16 spans. Every field/type/order/span checked; ASCII7,253,335 byte/character sums coincide. Representation/opening costs remain distinct.
contracts.CsvRecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared objects+header,new4MiB destination/finalization. Mapped=false/true: peer attribute/generated WriteRecordsAsync versus OfficeIMO WriteObjects ordinary object mapping. Invariant O dates for OfficeIMO; every header/value/type/date/order checked by OfficeIMO/Sylvan. Automatic writer strategies and async/sync contract disclosed.
contracts.CsvTypedAsyncBenchmarks: 50K headered identical TypedRecord class. OfficeIMO RowsAsAsync/async opener, peer attribute parser async enumeration/sync FromCsv opener, Sylvan GetRecordsAsync/async opener. Setup validates every field through actual methods; memory stream does not measure external async IO latency.
contracts.CsvTypedReadBenchmarks: 50K headered complete Name/Id/Date/Value class. Automatic OfficeIMO RowsAs, peer attribute parser, Sylvan GetRecords. Every mapped field/order/count validated in Setup; distinct from raw/manual construction.
contracts.CsvUtf8WriterBenchmarks: 100Kx4 unmanaged offsets/value buffers,no header,reused32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Public CsvRowWriter.WriteUtf8Row versus peer row.WriteUtf8. Same CRLF6,900,000B output/all bytes and fields checked, plus escaping/Unicode/null/empty/formula proof. No private NativeWriteApi adapter.
contracts.CsvWideReadBenchmarks: 50Kx32 ASCII fields/headerless. MaterializeStrings=false: peer borrowed UTF8, OfficeIMO normalized borrowed UTF8, Sylvan UTF16 spans; true materializes every field. Every1.6M-field value/order/width/count checked. ASCII length equivalence does not remove representation/parser allocation differences.
contracts.CsvWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared typed objects+header,new4MiB destination/full finalization. Peer row writer, OfficeIMO WriteObjects invariant O dates/default newline, Sylvan ObjectDataReader/CsvDataWriter default format. Every logical field/type/date/order checked independently. Valid formatting/output-length differences prohibit an identical-byte/format cost claim.

contracts.StringHeavyReadBenchmarks: 65,536 data rows plus header: eight text and three typed columns from the pinned upstream generator. Full expected fields/types/order/count checked outside timing; checksum/count inside. Peer borrowed raw text, default/prefetch and ReadOnlyMemory routes differ from ordinary GetValue strings/scalar objects in OfficeIMO/Sylvan. Byte/Stream routes are separate; no matched-materialization allocation claim for raw APIs.
contracts.MaterializedStringHeavyReadBenchmarks: Same complete eleven-field input, all strings materialized. Peer default versus InternStrings=true are separate policies. Numeric/date APIs and scalar boxing remain visible; full count/checksum consumed and fields/types/order checked. Fresh reader opening/scan/disposal included; byte/Stream variants separate.
contracts.SharedStringFirstRowBenchmarks: Public open through first Read/MoveNext, then disposal. Timed result is header-row availability; complete fields/input proved outside timing. Deflated/Stored XLSX separate. OfficeIMO qualifies the selected worksheet and loads complete referenced SST before delivery; peer public initialization/validation lifecycles differ. First-row caller latency is separate from full-sheet validation work and process-cold first-use.
contracts.SharedStringFullScanBenchmarks: Complete materialized eleven-field scan at65,536 data rows plus header, Stored XLSX. Stored rewrite preserves inflated parts. Full count/checksum consumed; expected fields/types/order checked. Opening/scan/disposal included; separate from first-row/borrowed/cache policies.
contracts.SharedStringBorrowedScanBenchmarks: Peer-only full borrowed UTF8 scan on Deflated/Stored XLSX at65,536 data rows, default versus PrefetchDecompression=true. Complete semantic proof/checksum/count. No paired OfficeIMO method in this class; the separate100K public UTF8 class provides OfficeIMO coverage.
contracts.SharedStringUtf8ReadBenchmarks: 100,000 data rows plus header, eight text and three typed columns, XLSX/XLSB and Deflated/Stored. Every normalized UTF8 byte and scalar field checked individually. Full byte-length/checksum/count consumed through public borrowing: OfficeIMO TryGetUtf8Text with normal GetValue for three scalars versus peer public borrowed row parsing. Each invocation opens a fresh reader and includes OfficeIMO complete validation/normalized SST loading, encoding/cache misses. Default/prefetch separate; no retained-cache or zero-allocation claim.

contracts.StringHeavyReadBenchmarks: 65,536 data rows plus header: eight text and three typed columns from the pinned upstream generator. Full expected fields/types/order/count checked outside timing; checksum/count inside. Peer borrowed raw text, default/prefetch and ReadOnlyMemory routes differ from ordinary GetValue strings/scalar objects in OfficeIMO/Sylvan. Byte/Stream routes are separate; no matched-materialization allocation claim for raw APIs.
contracts.MaterializedStringHeavyReadBenchmarks: Same complete eleven-field input, all strings materialized. Peer default versus InternStrings=true are separate policies. Numeric/date APIs and scalar boxing remain visible; full count/checksum consumed and fields/types/order checked. Fresh reader opening/scan/disposal included; byte/Stream variants separate.
contracts.SharedStringFirstRowBenchmarks: Public open through first Read/MoveNext, then disposal. Timed result is header-row availability; complete fields/input proved outside timing. Deflated/Stored XLSX separate. OfficeIMO qualifies the selected worksheet and materializes the complete selected shared-string table, including later unreferenced items, before delivery; peer public initialization/validation lifecycles differ. First-row caller latency is separate from full-sheet validation work and process-cold first-use.
contracts.SharedStringFullScanBenchmarks: Complete materialized eleven-field scan at 65,536 data rows plus header, Stored XLSX. Stored rewrite preserves inflated parts. Full count/checksum consumed; expected fields/types/order checked. Opening/scan/disposal included; separate from first-row/borrowed/cache policies.
contracts.SharedStringBorrowedScanBenchmarks: Peer-only full borrowed UTF8 scan on Deflated/Stored XLSX at 65,536 data rows, default versus PrefetchDecompression=true. Complete semantic proof/checksum/count. No paired OfficeIMO method in this class; the separate 100K public UTF8 class provides OfficeIMO coverage.
contracts.SharedStringUtf8ReadBenchmarks: 100,000 data rows plus header, eight text and three typed columns, XLSX/XLSB and Deflated/Stored. Every normalized UTF8 byte and scalar field checked individually. Full byte-length/checksum/count consumed through public borrowing: OfficeIMO TryGetUtf8Text with normal GetValue for three scalars versus peer public borrowed row parsing. Each invocation opens a fresh reader and includes OfficeIMO complete validation/normalized SST loading, encoding/cache misses. Default/prefetch separate; no retained-cache or zero-allocation claim.

hostObservation.limitation: Pre/post snapshots do not identify process roles, CPU during individual cases, or activity of processes absent at either endpoint. No live host audit or later-group inspection.

contracts.ArrowStringWriterBenchmarks: 100K four required Arrow string columns, prepared Arrow buffers outside timing; header c0..c3. Both reuse32MiB output, reset/finalize and return length. ExcelReader public WriteRecordBatch versus OfficeIMO public WriteRows/WriteUtf8 caller orchestration with ordinary Enumerable.Range/callback/column-access costs; no dedicated OfficeIMO RecordBatch writer is claimed. Complete fields/schema/output parts checked in Setup.
contracts.CompactWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared Name/Id/Date/Value objects plus header; new4MiB MemoryStream per operation, complete XLSX finalization, return length. OfficeIMO public IncludeCellReferences=false is configured compact output: header references and dimension remain; peer normal writer omits references/dimension. ExcelReader PrefetchWrite=true separate. Full fields/date styles/package integrity/independent readers checked; does not replace ordinary writer results.
contracts.ConfiguredXlsbWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared records plus header. OfficeIMO builds native spreadsheet model then Save, explicitly inline or SST. Peer public XLSB streaming writer with SST=true versus inline PrefetchWrite=true. Full fields/date styles/storage records/package parts validated. Same logical records do not make model and streaming allocation work equal, and inline/prefetch versus SST remain distinct policies.
contracts.MappedRecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prebuilt mapped objects, XLSX/XLSB plus header, new4MiB destination and full finalization. Peer generated record layout writes the mapped model; OfficeIMO ordinary public XLSX callback or XLSB model+Save writes the same fields. This is caller-output equivalence, not an automatic mapped writer API equivalence. Object/layout preparation outside timing; correct output validated.
contracts.NativeWriterBenchmarks: 50K Name/Id/Date/Value records plus header, native XLSB default writing. OfficeIMO builds workbook model then Save versus peer public row-streaming writer. Both current defaults use inline cells; peer carries an empty SST part, OfficeIMO omits it. Same fields/types/order/date styles and independent readability validated. Native XLS diagnostics are unselected and remain unranked separately.
contracts.RecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared attributed records, XLSX/XLSB plus header, new4MiB destination and complete finalization. Peer WriteRecordsAsync with attribute layout versus OfficeIMO normal XLSX row callback/XLSB model+Save. No automatic OfficeIMO attributed-record writer is implied. Full output values/styles/metadata and independent readability proved outside timing.
contracts.SharedStringWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared records plus header, new4MiB MemoryStream and finalization. Both select SST. OfficeIMO ordinary coordinates and configured coordinate omission are separate methods; peer omits coordinates/dimension. Header references/dimension remain in Office compact output. Complete fields/order/date-style/SST/package proof outside timing; ordinary and compact results stay separate.
contracts.StyledRowWriterBenchmarks: 100K numeric rows0..99999, no header, same retained32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Public true bold row defaults and authored bold values qualified through actual row/cell/style references, every value and earlier independent Excel evidence. OfficeIMO authored resolved cell XFs/coordinates and peer row defaults/no coordinates differ structurally but produce qualified bold values. Style pipeline cost remains visible.
contracts.Utf8WriterBenchmarks: 100K four prepared unmanaged UTF8 value buffers/offsets, no header, retained32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Both public UTF8 APIs consume exact inputs; OfficeIMO normal WriteRows callback/enumeration is included. No private native WriteApi adapter. Every field/UTF8 value/escaping proof and produced package parts are checked outside timing.

contracts.ArrowStringWriterBenchmarks: 100K four required Arrow string columns, prepared Arrow buffers outside timing; header c0..c3. Both reuse32MiB output, reset/finalize and return length. ExcelReader public WriteRecordBatch versus OfficeIMO public WriteRows/WriteUtf8 caller orchestration with ordinary Enumerable.Range/callback/column-access costs; no dedicated OfficeIMO RecordBatch writer is claimed. Complete fields/schema/output parts checked in Setup.
contracts.CompactWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared Name/Id/Date/Value objects plus header; new4MiB MemoryStream per operation, complete XLSX finalization, return length. OfficeIMO public IncludeCellReferences=false is configured compact output: header references and dimension remain; peer normal writer omits references/dimension. ExcelReader PrefetchWrite=true separate. Full fields/date styles/package integrity/independent readers checked; does not replace ordinary writer results.
contracts.ConfiguredXlsbWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared records plus header. OfficeIMO builds native spreadsheet model then Save, explicitly inline or SST. Peer public XLSB streaming writer with SST=true versus inline PrefetchWrite=true. Full fields/date styles/storage records/package parts validated. Same logical records do not make model and streaming allocation work equal, and inline/prefetch versus SST remain distinct policies.
contracts.MappedRecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prebuilt mapped objects, XLSX/XLSB plus header, new4MiB destination and full finalization. Peer generated record layout writes the mapped model; OfficeIMO ordinary public XLSX callback or XLSB model+Save writes the same fields. This is caller-output equivalence, not an automatic mapped writer API equivalence. Object/layout preparation outside timing; correct output validated.
contracts.NativeWriterBenchmarks: 50K Name/Id/Date/Value records plus header, native XLSB default writing. OfficeIMO builds workbook model then Save versus peer public row-streaming writer. Both current defaults use inline cells; peer carries an empty SST part, OfficeIMO omits it. Same fields/types/order/date styles and independent readability validated. Native XLS diagnostics are unselected and remain unranked separately.
contracts.RecordWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared attributed records, XLSX/XLSB plus header, new4MiB destination and complete finalization. Peer WriteRecordsAsync with attribute layout versus OfficeIMO normal XLSX row callback/XLSB model+Save. No automatic OfficeIMO attributed-record writer is implied. Full output values/styles/metadata and independent readability proved outside timing.
contracts.SharedStringWriterBenchmarks: 50K prepared records plus header, new4MiB MemoryStream and finalization. Both select SST. OfficeIMO ordinary coordinates and configured coordinate omission are separate methods; peer omits coordinates/dimension. Header references/dimension remain in Office compact output. Complete fields/order/date-style/SST/package proof outside timing; ordinary and compact results stay separate.
contracts.StyledRowWriterBenchmarks: 100K numeric rows0..99999, no header, same retained32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Public true bold row defaults and authored bold values qualified through actual row/cell/style references, every value and earlier independent Excel evidence. OfficeIMO authored resolved cell XFs/coordinates and peer row defaults/no coordinates differ structurally but produce qualified bold values. Style pipeline cost remains visible.
contracts.Utf8WriterBenchmarks: 100K four prepared unmanaged UTF8 value buffers/offsets, no header, retained32MiB destination/reset/finalization. Both public UTF8 APIs consume exact inputs; OfficeIMO normal WriteRows callback/enumeration is included. No private native WriteApi adapter. Every field/UTF8 value/escaping proof and produced package parts are checked outside timing.
